professionalSummary.text: Software engineer on the payments reconciliation team at Marlow & Pike Building Society from October 2021 to July 2024, working on services that match card and faster-payment records against the ledger.

experienceHighlights.text: Implemented matching rules for returned faster payments in the Kotlin reconciliation service, building to the design agreed by the team's principal engineer.
experienceHighlights.witness: Implemented the matching rules for returned faster payments in the Kotlin reconciliation service, building to the design the team's principal engineer had agreed.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote unit and integration tests for the matching engine using fixtures from anonymised return files and reviewed pull requests from two other engineers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote unit and integration tests for the matching engine, with fixtures built from anonymised return files, and reviewed pull requests from two other engineers.

experienceHighlights.text: Joined daily break-review calls with payments operations to investigate unmatched items, raising defects when matching rules were wrong and retesting fixes against previous day's files.
experienceHighlights.witness: Joined the daily break-review call with payments operations, investigating unmatched items and raising defects where a matching rule was wrong, then retesting each fix against the previous day's file.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared release notes and change tickets for the reconciliation service, with releases approved by the change manager before deployment in the agreed change window.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared release notes and change tickets for the reconciliation service; each release was approved by the change manager before deployment in the agreed change window.
